title: CI Failure Fix Roadmap
description: Track current main CI failures and fixes.

1-1.label: Windows Rust core SQLite temp file-lock failures

decisions.q: What is the dominant CI failure mode?
decisions.answer: Windows-only Rust core cargo test failures caused by temp SQLite files being deleted while still locked, plus one timing assertion that is too strict for Windows CI.
decisions.note: Latest failing run 28283362232: macOS and Ubuntu passed; windows-2025 failed in Test Rust core.

1-1.notes: Added test cleanup helper for Windows SQLite file locks and replaced direct temp dir removal in Rust core tests.

1-2.label: Windows Rust core timing-sensitive bulk-write assertion
1-2.notes: Kept bulk-write timing hard assertions for non-Windows; Windows validates functional FTS/index contract without slow-runner timing gate.

1-3.label: CI verification and main branch cleanup

decisions.answer: Push the fix to origin/main and use GitHub Actions windows-2025 as the real Windows validation runner.
decisions.note: The repo has no readable .parallels VM config in this workspace, so local real-Windows validation is unavailable.

1-3.notes: Local CI-equivalent checks passed: npm run build, cargo test, targeted rust-index-engine vitest, and release artifact contract vitest. Windows validation requires GitHub Actions because no .parallels VM config is present.
